**F1:** 0.015 | **Precision:** 0.671 | **Recall:** 0.007  

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `0d302ce7`  
**Description:**
Matches companies ending in 'AG', ensuring the preceding word is part of the name (e.g., A1 Telekom Austria AG) and not just a fragment.

**Content:**
```
(?:^|[\s,])([A-Z][a-zA-Z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df]+(?:\s+[A-Z][a-zA-Z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df]+)*(?:\s+&\s+[A-Z][a-zA-Z\u00e4\u00f6\u00fc\u00df]+)*\s+AG)\b
```
